name: UNSPECIFIED
doc: Place holder and should never appear in a Workflow execution history

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_STARTED
doc: Workflow execution has been triggered/started It contains Workflow execution inputs, as well as Workflow timeout configurations

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_COMPLETED
doc: Workflow execution has successfully completed and contains Workflow execution results

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED
doc: Workflow execution has unsuccessfully completed and contains the Workflow execution error

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TIMED_OUT
doc: Workflow execution has timed out by the Temporal Server Usually due to the Workflow having not been completed within timeout settings

name: WORKFLOW_TASK_SCHEDULED
doc: Workflow Task has been scheduled and the SDK client should now be able to process any new history events

name: WORKFLOW_TASK_STARTED
doc: Workflow Task has started and the SDK client has picked up the Workflow Task and is processing new history events

name: WORKFLOW_TASK_COMPLETED
doc: Workflow Task has completed The SDK client picked up the Workflow Task and processed new history events SDK client may or may not ask the Temporal Server to do additional work, such as: EVENT_TYPE_ACTIVITY_TASK_SCHEDULED EVENT_TYPE_TIMER_STARTED EVENT_TYPE_UPSERT_WORKFLOW_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTES EVENT_TYPE_MARKER_RECORDED EVENT_TYPE_START_CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED EVENT_TYPE_REQUEST_CANCEL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED EVENT_TYPE_SIGNAL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED EVENT_TYPE_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_COMPLETED EVENT_TYPE_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED EVENT_TYPE_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CANCELED EVENT_TYPE_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CONTINUED_AS_NEW

name: WORKFLOW_TASK_TIMED_OUT
doc: Workflow Task encountered a timeout Either an SDK client with a local cache was not available at the time, or it took too long for the SDK client to process the task

name: WORKFLOW_TASK_FAILED
doc: Workflow Task encountered a failure Usually this means that the Workflow was non-deterministic However, the Workflow reset functionality also uses this event

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_SCHEDULED
doc: Activity Task was scheduled The SDK client should pick up this activity task and execute This event type contains activity inputs, as well as activity timeout configurations

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_STARTED
doc: Activity Task has started executing The SDK client has picked up the Activity Task and is processing the Activity invocation

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_COMPLETED
doc: Activity Task has finished successfully The SDK client has picked up and successfully completed the Activity Task This event type contains Activity execution results

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_FAILED
doc: Activity Task has finished unsuccessfully The SDK picked up the Activity Task but unsuccessfully completed it This event type contains Activity execution errors

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_TIMED_OUT
doc: Activity has timed out according to the Temporal Server Activity did not complete within the timeout settings

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_CANCEL_REQUESTED
doc: A request to cancel the Activity has occurred The SDK client will be able to confirm cancellation of an Activity during an Activity heartbeat

name: ACTIVITY_TASK_CANCELED
doc: Activity has been cancelled

name: TIMER_STARTED
doc: A timer has started

name: TIMER_FIRED
doc: A timer has fired

name: TIMER_CANCELED
doc: A time has been cancelled

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CANCEL_REQUESTED
doc: A request has been made to cancel the Workflow execution

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CANCELED
doc: SDK client has confirmed the cancellation request and the Workflow execution has been cancelled

name: REQUEST_CANCEL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED
doc: Workflow has requested that the Temporal Server try to cancel another Workflow

name: REQUEST_CANCEL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED
doc: Temporal Server could not cancel the targeted Workflow This is usually because the target Workflow could not be found

name: EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CANCEL_REQUESTED
doc: Temporal Server has successfully requested the cancellation of the target Workflow

name: MARKER_RECORDED
doc: A marker has been recorded. This event type is transparent to the Temporal Server The Server will only store it and will not try to understand it.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_SIGNALED
doc: Workflow has received a Signal event The event type contains the Signal name, as well as a Signal payload

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TERMINATED
doc: Workflow execution has been forcefully terminated This is usually because the terminate Workflow API was called

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CONTINUED_AS_NEW
doc: Workflow has successfully completed and a new Workflow has been started within the same transaction Contains last Workflow execution results as well as new Workflow execution inputs

name: START_CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED
doc: Temporal Server will try to start a child Workflow

name: START_CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED
doc: Child Workflow execution cannot be started/triggered Usually due to a child Workflow ID collision

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_STARTED
doc: Child Workflow execution has successfully started/triggered

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_COMPLETED
doc: Child Workflow execution has successfully completed

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED
doc: Child Workflow execution has unsuccessfully completed

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_CANCELED
doc: Child Workflow execution has been cancelled

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TIMED_OUT
doc: Child Workflow execution has timed out by the Temporal Server

name: CHILD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TERMINATED
doc: Child Workflow execution has been terminated

name: SIGNAL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_INITIATED
doc: Temporal Server will try to Signal the targeted Workflow Contains the Signal name, as well as a Signal payload

name: SIGNAL_EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED
doc: Temporal Server cannot Signal the targeted Workflow Usually because the Workflow could not be found

name: EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_SIGNALED
doc: Temporal Server has successfully Signaled the targeted Workflow

name: UPSERT_WORKFLOW_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTES
doc: Workflow search attributes should be updated and synchronized with the visibility store

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_UPDATE_ADMITTED
doc: An update was admitted. Note that not all admitted updates result in this event. See UpdateAdmittedEventOrigin for situations in which this event is created.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_UPDATE_ACCEPTED
doc: An update was accepted (i.e. passed validation, perhaps because no validator was defined)

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_UPDATE_REJECTED
doc: This event is never written to history.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_UPDATE_COMPLETED
doc: An update completed

name: WORKFLOW_PROPERTIES_MODIFIED_EXTERNALLY
doc: Some property or properties of the workflow as a whole have changed by non-workflow code. The distinction of external vs. command-based modification is important so the SDK can maintain determinism when using the command-based approach.

name: ACTIVITY_PROPERTIES_MODIFIED_EXTERNALLY
doc: Some property or properties of an already-scheduled activity have changed by non-workflow code. The distinction of external vs. command-based modification is important so the SDK can maintain determinism when using the command-based approach.

name: WORKFLOW_PROPERTIES_MODIFIED
doc: Workflow properties modified by user workflow code

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_SCHEDULED
doc: A Nexus operation was scheduled using a ScheduleNexusOperation command.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_STARTED
doc: An asynchronous Nexus operation was started by a Nexus handler.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_COMPLETED
doc: A Nexus operation completed successfully.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_FAILED
doc: A Nexus operation failed.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_CANCELED
doc: A Nexus operation completed as canceled.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_TIMED_OUT
doc: A Nexus operation timed out.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_CANCEL_REQUESTED
doc: A Nexus operation was requested to be canceled using a RequestCancelNexusOperation command.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_OPTIONS_UPDATED
doc: Workflow execution options updated by user.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_CANCEL_REQUEST_COMPLETED
doc: A cancellation request for a Nexus operation was successfully delivered to the Nexus handler.

name: NEXUS_OPERATION_CANCEL_REQUEST_FAILED
doc: A cancellation request for a Nexus operation resulted in an error.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_PAUSED
doc: An event that indicates that the workflow execution has been paused.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_UNPAUSED
doc: An event that indicates that the previously paused workflow execution has been unpaused.

name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TIME_SKIPPING_TRANSITIONED
doc: An event that indicates time skipping advanced time or was disabled automatically after a bound was reached.
